title: Expansion Retention Credit Arc + Security-Q Preflight for Renewals
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Proposal: a two-part playbook to improve renewal conversion and expansion velocity by (1) introducing a Renewal Credit Arc (RCA) — a smoothing and crediting mechanism that rewards predictable usage while avoiding abrupt post-renewal true-ups — and (2) implementing a Security Questionnaire Preflight (SQ-Preflight) that pre-populates common SQ answers and surfaces outstanding items early in the renewal cycle. Goal: reduce churn at renewal, increase net expansion ARR, and minimize legal/security friction for enterprise renewals.
detailed_scope: RCA: design a crediting ladder that converts committed overage into rolling credits for the next 3 billing periods instead of immediate invoice true-ups; define thresholds for partial true-ups when usage deviation exceeds 40% of committed baseline. Offer a multi-year smoothing option: customers who commit 24 months can opt into tiered effective discounts that increase on-year-2, with built-in monthly drawdown of credit buckets to keep cost transparency. SQ-Preflight: build a template mapping of 120 common questionnaire items -> canonical answers, integrate with renewal workflow (Salesforce or HubSpot) to surface outstanding security controls 90/60/30 days before renewal. Provide self-serve docs and optional SOC/KMS attestation artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Productized RCA config added to renewal contracts UI; 2) Sales can enable RCA and select 12/24/36 month smoothing; 3) Billing engine supports rolling credits and partial true-up logic with audit logs; 4) SQ-Preflight template stored in Drive + linked to renewal record; 5) Two pilot customers complete renewals using RCA + SQ-Preflight with post-renew feedback collected.
success_metrics: - Renewal conversion delta vs baseline: +3%-5% target; - Expansion ARR uplift in pilot cohort: +8% median; - Mean time-to-SQ-complete: from 28 days to <10 days; - Number of post-renew true-up disputes: reduce by 60%.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Accounting and legal complexity around deferred credits. Mitigation: define GL impacts, cap credit lifespan at 3 months, require finance sign-off and sample journal entries. Risk: Sales adoption friction. Mitigation: build clear playbook, sales commission rules for credited expansions, and provide enablement sessions. Risk: SQ templating inaccuracies. Mitigation: QA loop with Security team and sample customers, flag high-risk answers for manual review.
out_of_scope: Full rework of existing invoicing system. Long-term policy changes to standard T&Cs (we will ship as contract addendum templates). Deep automation with customers' GRC tooling (future phase).
open_questions: 1) What cap should we set on cumulative credits to avoid revenue leakage? (Finance suggestion: 50% of monthly commit). 2) Should credits be transferrable across seats or product lines? 3) How will commissions be calculated for credited expansion?
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (4w): finalize RCA rules, legal addendum, and finance journal entries; build SQ-Preflight template. Phase 2 (6w): implement billing changes and UI toggles; integrate SQ-Preflight to renewal workflow. Phase 3 (8w): pilot with 3 customers, iterate, and prepare rollout. Include release notes and enablement for Sales and CS.
rollout_notes: Pilot cohort: mid-market accounts with predictable usage and existing SSO/SOC docs. Rollout criteria: successful accounting sign-off, two completed pilots with positive CS feedback, and <10% manual intervention rate.
